evidence.title: Order import and reconciliation internship
evidence.content: During a twelve-week internship I owned an order import feature. I designed idempotency keys, implemented validation and retries, and added integration tests for duplicate uploads and partial failures. I compared a database transaction with an asynchronous outbox and documented why the bounded transaction was sufficient for the import size. A senior engineer reviewed the implementation before internal release. I also added structured error logs and a rollback checklist. The account describes substantive work, but supervisor confirmation, code reviews, load-test results, and release records are not supplied.
